summary: Adds one animation frame entry to the owning object's array of 28-byte pit-crew animation elements. Allocates a grown array (4-byte count header plus (this[28]+1) elements of 28 bytes), constructs each new slot with FunctionCallWrapper_1fb0, copies the existing elements from this+0x74 into it, zeroes each old element's scratch slot, destroys the old elements with ShortComputation_d4d0 and frees the old array with its header via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Then stores the grown pointer at this+0x74, allocates the new last element's scratch buffer (4 * this[26] bytes), and populates it per entry: sub_5518A0 converts a3 to a string handle, sub_551560 checks its validity, and WideStringComparisonWalkingLinkedList(a2) walks the wide-string linked list whose result is stored into the scratch slot. On the first entry only it also stores a5, a float read from the string handle at +8, and the PitCrewAnimationStringMapper(a4) animation ID (or literal 24 when a4 is null). When the population loop breaks early it logs a cube loading error via StringRelocationCopy + StringSplitLoop + DebugLogWrite. The element count this+0x70 is only incremented when every entry was populated.
